summary: Apply Miss Punch now has In time and Out time (time pickers), Year as a dropdown (this/last year), and checks everything at once before sending: real days of the month, past days only, no day twice, out after in, remarks required. The server re-checks (30-day window, duplicates, joining date) and its field messages appear under the fields. A pending request can be cancelled (with confirmation); the list shows In/Out, "Pending with", a Cancelled tab with the cancelled time.
testSteps: Log in to the TrueHR app (Android 1.2.0) as an Employee with no reportees (e.g. sneha.iyer@truehr.example / Demo@12345). Attendance > Apply Miss Punch. Enter day 3, current month, In 09:30, Out 18:30, remarks "forgot to punch" > Submit. Expected: "Your miss-punch request has been submitted." View Miss Punch > Pending shows In/Out 09:30 – 18:30 and "Pending with: <manager>". Tap Cancel Request > "Cancel request". Expected: moves to the Cancelled tab with "Cancelled on <date, time>".
negativeTests: 1. Days '0,32' (November). Expected: '0, 32 are not days of November 2026 (1–30)'. 2. Empty form. Expected: 'Enter at least one day of the month (e.g. 3 or 3,5)', 'In time is required', 'Out time is required', 'Remarks is required'. 3. Tomorrow's day. Expected: 'Miss-punch is only for past days — dd-mm-yyyy is today or later'. 4. '3,3'. Expected: 'Day 3 is entered twice'. 5. Out 09:00, In 18:00. Expected: 'Out time must be after In time'. 6. A day already requested. Expected (server): 'Already requested: dd-mm-yyyy'. 7. A day older than 30 days. Expected (server): 'Miss-punch can only be applied for the last 30 days (from …) — … is too old'.
automated: ValidatorsTest.missPunchRules; V2DtoDecodingTest.missPunch; backend scripts/v2/test-android.js "E7: miss-punch messages"; on-device smoke: 0,32 + empty times/remarks (android-screens/07_misspunch_negative.jpg)
v1Impact: None (v1 unchanged; app now sends v2 with inTime/outTime).

bug: Logout did not clear Room (another user's buffered tours/geotags uploaded under the next login); one failing item stalled the whole sync; geotags lost their capture time.
summary: Sign-out (SessionCleaner) uploads what it can (8s cap), unregisters the push token, wipes the Room buffer, then clears the session — each step isolated. Tours and geo-tags now record the owner (Room v2 migration keeps existing rows); sync only sends the signed-in user's rows and a new login deletes other users' rows. A 4xx (other than 401/408/429) parks that item with its error and the queue continues; network/5xx retry later. Geo-tags send capturedAt; v2 backend stores it (within 7 days, not future).
testSteps: 1. User A: Tour Management > take a geo-tag in airplane mode. 2. Sign out, sign in as user B, go online. Expected: A's geo-tag is never uploaded as B. 3. As A (online) take a geo-tag; it shows in the geo-tag list with the time it was taken.
negativeTests: 1. A tour the server rejects with 404 does not block later geo-tags.
automated: SessionCleanerTest (order, failures, adopt, SyncPolicy); test-android.js "A5: geo-tag capturedAt (v2 only)" (6 checks incl. v1 unchanged)
v1Impact: capturedAt is honoured on v2 only; v1 ignores it exactly as before.

releaseNotes: TrueHR 1.2.0: • Clear messages on every form, shown next to the field. • Leave: half day with First/Second half, reason required, balances after pending requests, holiday & restricted-holiday list, certificate upload, cancel with confirmation. • Miss punch: in/out time, validation, cancel a pending request. • Resignation: your access continues during the notice period; withdraw before final approval; attach a letter. • New "Request a change" for personal, address and bank details. • Full read-only profile. • Support tickets with subject, number, replies, cancel/reopen. • Payslip filters. • Safer sign-out, approximate location supported, fixes for crashes and offline sync.
